tools.name: apply_machine_patches
tools.description: Create a non-mutating behavioral proposal by applying semantic machine patches in memory through the Stately API. Returns the updated document, the structured patches, and a concise behavioral summary; it never writes files or invokes Git. Use graph entity IDs: top-level XState states commonly use <machine-id>.<state-key> (for example job.running). Use camelCase operations such as createTransition, not snake_case names.

tools.name: generate_graph_paths
tools.description: Generate shortest or simple paths through the Stately API. XState source must be complete executable source (including imports) because it runs natively in an isolated sandbox. max sets page size (default 5, maximum 1000); pass nextCursor as cursor with the same input to retrieve more. Pagination distinguishes complete bounded generation from budget exhaustion; it does not establish application coverage.

SCXML defaults to structural mode; executionMode="native" opts into sandboxed XState v6 execution. advanceTimeMs runs virtual timers after the supplied events. Returns execution metadata and optional completion output.
